verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions registrable outbound HTTP webhooks. The alerting docs say users define "who is notified, and how" and can "route issues to the correct system or team using notifications," but no notification channel is named as a webhook. That is an adjacent capability and does not establish that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to events via HTTP callbacks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
